title: Unifying Central Flow, Rod Flow, and the Edge Coupling
abstract: arXiv:2611.08358v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: At the edge of stability, the iterates of gradient descent oscillate along the sharp directions of the Hessian. This poses a significant challenge for continuous-time models as the usual continuous-time approximation -- the gradient flow -- admits no oscillations. Several continuous-time models have been proposed to capture the behavior at the edge of stability, among them central flow and rod flow. Although both models can be interpreted as performing a coarse-graining in time, the connection between them remains poorly understood. Here we show that both flows can be derived from a third object, the edge coupling: a functional on consecutive iterates whose critical points are the fixed points and period-two orbits of gradient descent. It is revealed that the two flows correspond to coarse-grainings at different time scales. translated_title: 统一中心流、杆流与边缘耦合
translated_abstract: 在稳定性边缘，梯度下降的迭代点会沿着Hessian矩阵的尖锐方向发生振荡。这对连续时间模型构成了重大挑战，因为通常的连续时间近似——梯度流——并不允许振荡。已有若干连续时间模型被提出来刻画稳定性边缘处的行为，其中包括中心流和杆流。尽管这两种模型都可以被解释为在时间上执行粗粒化，但它们之间的联系仍然知之甚少。本文证明，这两种流都可以从第三个对象——边缘耦合——推导出来：边缘耦合是定义在相邻迭代点上的一个泛函，其临界点正是梯度下降的不动点和周期二轨道。研究揭示，这两种流对应于不同时间尺度上的粗粒化：杆流仅在最快的时间尺度上进行粗粒化，而中心流则在快……
tldr: 本文提出“边缘耦合”这一泛函，证明中心流与杆流均可由它推导得出，二者分别对应不同时间尺度上的时间粗粒化，从而统一了刻画梯度下降稳定性边缘行为的两种连续时间模型。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the "edge coupling," a functional on consecutive iterates, and shows that both central flow and rod flow can be derived from it as coarse-grainings at different time scales, unifying two continuous-time models of gradient descent at the edge of stability.
